sources.title: Visa Form
sources.officialityEvidence: The live moi.gov.af Ministry of Interior service page has current 2026 ministry content and links to a visa form, but supplies no eligibility, issuance, nationality or entry rules.
sources.supportingExcerpt: For the visa form click here.

sources.title: Tourist Visa
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Afghanistan
sources.officialityEvidence: The live mfa.gov.af site identifies the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan and publishes current 2026 ministry content.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A tourist visa is issued based on travel purpose and documents, including a valid passport and hotel booking confirmation.

sources.title: Visa: current categories and issuance procedures
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Afghanistan
sources.officialityEvidence: The live MFA consular page identifies the Islamic Emirate's Foreigners Visas deputy and links current tourist, visitor, arrival and other visa procedures.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa on arrival requires an official domestic-organization letter or an invitation from an international organization operating in Afghanistan.
